accessibility.seoDescription: Accessibility statement for the {{city}} community portal — our commitment, the standard we target, known limitations, and how to report a barrier.
accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: The {{city}} community portal is built and maintained by volunteers. We want everyone in the community to be able to read our pages, use our services guides, and reach the right office without barriers. This page explains what we are working toward, what we have done so far, and where the gaps still are.

commitment.title: Our commitment
commitment.body1: We are working toward making this portal usable by as many people as possible, including people with disabilities, older residents, and anyone browsing on a slow connection or a small phone screen.
commitment.body2: Accessibility is treated as ongoing work rather than a finished checklist. We review new pages and features as they are added, and we fix issues when people report them.

standard.title: The standard we target
standard.body: We are working toward conformance with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, Level AA — the standard most widely used for public-sector and civic websites.
standard.note: This is a statement of work in progress, not a claim of legal compliance. It also does not speak for the {{city}} government or any official government website.

measures.title: What we have built in so far
measures.description: These are the practices we have already put into place across the portal.

items.title: Keyboard and focus
items.description: Interactive elements are reachable and operable with a keyboard, with a visible focus indicator.

items.title: Structure and headings
items.description: Pages use a single top-level heading and a logical heading order, so screen reader users can navigate between sections.

items.title: Labels and alternative text
items.description: Form fields, icon-only buttons, tables, and images carry text labels or descriptions, and decorative icons are hidden from assistive technology.

items.title: Text and contrast
items.description: Body text and controls are checked for readable colour contrast, and text reflows without horizontal scrolling on small screens.

items.title: Touch targets and reduced motion
items.description: Links and buttons are large enough to tap comfortably on a phone, and animations respect your device's reduced-motion setting.

items.title: Language and translation
items.description: The portal ships in English and Tagalog, so key information is not limited to a single language.

limitations.title: Known limitations
limitations.description: We know these parts are not yet where we want them to be.

items.title: Not yet fully audited
items.description: We have not yet run a complete third-party accessibility audit across every page of the portal.

items.title: Legacy content
items.description: Some imported service guides and news items are plain documents. They may not yet be as navigable as our own pages.

items.title: Embedded third-party content
items.description: Features such as the embedded map, weather, and Facebook feed come from outside services. We do not control their accessibility and can only report problems to their providers.

items.title: Documents and images
items.description: Some attached PDFs and scanned images are not yet tagged or transcribed, which can make them harder to read with assistive technology.

feedback.title: Tell us if you hit a barrier
feedback.body1: If something on this portal is difficult or impossible for you to use, we want to know. There is no wrong way to report it — a short note is enough.
feedback.body2: Please tell us which page you were on, what you were trying to do, and what happened. If you can, include the browser and device you were using.
feedback.responseTime: Volunteers aim to reply within 2–3 business days. For urgent or official matters, contact the city government directly instead.

helpNote.title: Need help instead of a report?
helpNote.body: If you would rather have someone help you find the office or information you need, visit the {{city}} contact page for city hall details, department lines, and emergency hotlines.
